thread:
incident-bot: PagerDuty HIGH alert fired: INC-8342 - quota-mapper anomaly - 1.2k 429s in 2m for /v1/generate -> paging oncall

pagerduty: PD note: alert escalated to oncall rotation (ryan). Please ack to stop repeats.

ryan (oncall): acked. I'll take it. Looking now. :eyes:

leo (eng-sre): seeing burst of 429s in prod logs too. Quota-mapper returns 500->429 cascade. Dashboard: https://grafana/redwood/alerts/INC-8342

mike (platform): any recent deploys to quota-mapper or gateway? I see a config push 03:12 UTC from feature/optimize-ttl. Could be related.

ryan (oncall): checking deploy history... yup - config: quota-ttl changed from 3600 -> 0 in feature flag rollout at 03:12. That would invalidate caches.

leo (eng-sre): logs from quota-mapper (tail):
```
2026-03-14T03:12:05Z quota-mapper INFO apply-config commit=ab12ef
2026-03-14T03:12:07Z quota-mapper WARN cache-ttl=0 effective
2026-03-14T03:12:09Z quota-mapper ERROR cache-miss flood tenant=~all status=throttle
```

ryan (oncall): that explains sudden invalidation -> backend rate limiter getting huge head-of-line. Customers hit 429 because quota checks fallback to enforcement.

sara (oncall-backup): can we flip the feature flag back? Is that quick?

mike (platform): yes, reverting flag should be instant for new requests. I'll roll it back and restart 1 pod just to be safe. Doing: `kubectl -n prod set env deploy/quota-mapper QUOTA_TTL=3600`

incident-bot: action logged: revert-request by mike (platform) at 03:18 UTC.

leo (eng-sre): also provisioning bypass rule on gateway for high-traffic tenants so they don't get throttled mid-fix. Applying temp policy: `route.override.throttle=false` for tenant tags: enterprise.

csm-alex: heads up: Acme and NovaApps reported 429s via support. They are on dedicated plans. I'll notify them we're mitigating and will update in 15m.

ryan (oncall): mike, did revert apply?

mike (platform): revert applied at 03:19:12 - rollout status shows all quota-mapper replicas updated. Restarted pod qmap-3 for cache warm.

leo (eng-sre): watching error rates... error% falling from 55% -> 18% in last 2 mins.

ryan (oncall): can someone confirm PD acknowledgement so it stops re-paging? I've already acked but PD shows pending escalations.

pagerduty: Incident acknowledged by ryan (oncall) at 03:19:35. Escalation paused.

sara (oncall-backup): quick smoke: run a few synthetic calls to /v1/generate for tenant Acme to verify 200s.

ryan (oncall): running curl test now... `curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" https://api.redwood/v1/generate -H 'x-tenant: acme'` -> 200.

leo (eng-sre): production metrics showing 2xx recovery curve, 429s dropping to normal baseline. Cache warm-up latencies increased a bit but acceptable.

csm-alex: emailed Acme & NovaApps update: "we observed a config regression that temporarily disabled quota TTL, causing transient throttles. We've reverted and are monitoring; will follow up with RCA." They replied: "Thanks — please keep us posted."

ryan (oncall): starting short post-incident thread: root cause looks like config change merged without e2e guard for TTL=0. Immediate mitigation: revert flag + gateway bypass. Next: block TTL=0 merges in CI and add canary rollout.

mike (platform): creating rollback PR notes and tagging deploy owner. Also adding a deploy-time validation check to prevent TTL=0 in our config schema.

leo (eng-sre): creating alert tweak: make the quota-mapper 429 spike alert include recent config changes so oncall sees suspected config-related root cause faster.

sara (oncall-backup): FYI I'm taking over monitoring for the next 25min; ryan if you need to step away ping me.

ryan (oncall): handing off to sara — I'm due for a breather. All stable for now. Leave PD status as acknowledged.

pagerduty: note: oncall handoff recorded: ryan -> sara at 03:27 UTC.

incident-bot: incident status: mitigated - 429s resolved; monitoring for 30m. Postmortem assigned: eng-sre (leo) + platform (mike) + devex.

csm-alex: tracking follow-up for customers: provide timeline + what changed + protections added.

leo (eng-sre): quick action items I'll own: 1) RCA draft, 2) add CI guard, 3) tweak alert to include config diff.

mike (platform): I'll add deploy validation + create hotfix PR.

sara (oncall-backup): leaving thread open until monitoring window expires. If anything spikes I'll re-alert. Good job everyone. :thumbsup:

ryan (oncall): thanks team. Will sync on postmortem tomorrow.

incident-bot: Incident INC-8342 status updated to RESOLVED at 03:40 UTC (auto-close pending if no regressions).
